Thanks for trying the free repository preflight. Please share only information you are authorized to make public. **Do not paste the full JSON report**, source code, private repository names or paths, tokens, or secrets. The report can contain an absolute local path and file names.

### Run status

- [ ] I ran the command and got a verdict
- [ ] I tried to run it but was blocked
- [ ] I could not find or understand the run instructions

### Safe details

- Host and OS (for example, Claude Code on macOS):
- Install/run method (pip or clone):
- Verdict, if any (`DISTILL`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, `BLOCKED`):
- Repository type (for example, Python library; no private name or URL):
- What happened or what step was unclear (redact paths and names):
